walkthroughs.body_html: Ukiyo-e means 'pictures of the floating world'. Hokusai made the world-famous Great Wave print around 1831, using woodblock printing in blue and white.
Chinese painters used ink wash on paper or silk to suggest mist, mountains and bamboo with few strokes. Empty space (negative space) is as important as marks.
In both China and Japan, calligraphy is a fine art. The same brush, ink and paper as painting are used. A line's energy matters as much as the word.
